landing.title: The dashboard that powers your Discord server
landing.subtitle: Automate rewards, customize shops, launch mini-games and keep a clear view of activity. Everything is centralized, clear and fast.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need for a living economy
landing.featuresSubtitle: Complete tools, clear rules, and detailed logs.

feature1.title: Smart rewards
feature1.text: Rules per action, multipliers, daily and streaks to engage the community.

feature2.title: Configurable mini-games
feature2.text: Flip, roulette, crash and more, with precise settings and controlled house edge.

feature3.title: Logs & leaderboard
feature3.text: Detailed history, filters, dynamic leaderboard and global overview.

feature4.title: Modern shop
feature4.text: Items, prices, stock and visibility. A clean, fast catalog to manage.

feature5.title: Twitch integration
feature5.text: Connection, live rewards, automation and stream-focused bonuses.

feature6.title: Full customization
feature6.text: Every server is unique. Clear settings and an admin-friendly UI.

landing.splitTitle: A clear panel built for speed
landing.splitText: Enable modules, adjust odds and manage economies in a few clicks. Settings are explained so any admin can move forward without friction.
landing.ctaText: Sign in to find your servers or invite the bot.

docHub.title: ECONOMY BOT Documentation
docHub.subtitle: Two separate spaces for clarity: a complete guide for {0} and a dedicated guide for {1}.
docHub.chooseText: Each guide covers the full functionality and best practices.
docHub.importantText: This documentation only covers server admins and users.
docHub.adminText: Full dashboard configuration: currency, daily, auto gains, shop, lootbox, inventories, logs, Twitch and games.
docHub.userText: Discord commands, shop, inventory, market, lootbox and games with all the rules to know.

docAdmin.title: Server Admin Documentation
docAdmin.subtitle: Complete support guide for the economy bot administration: where to click, how to configure, and how each module works on Discord and the website.

hero.start2: Invite the bot to the server
hero.supportText: Any change requires saving. Members see updates immediately.

overview.title: Overview
overview.text: The dashboard centralizes economy and feature configuration. You can enable/disable each module and control server rules.
overview.list1: Each tab matches a module: economy, shop, inventories, games, logs.
overview.list2: Changes are applied when saved and visible to members right away.
overview.list3: Bot Discord permissions affect actions (roles, channels, logs).
overview.access1: Home page → My servers → select the server.
overview.access2: Open the tab to configure (sidebar menu).
overview.caption: Server admin dashboard overview (stats cards + module access).

economy.title: Currency & daily
economy.currencyText: Currency is the base of all transactions: purchases, sales, games and daily.
economy.currencyList1: Name & symbol: global display in the bot and website.
economy.currencyList2: Starting balance: granted on first connection.
economy.currencyList4: User balance: set, add or remove an amount (with confirmation).
economy.currencyList5: Balance is recalculated automatically after purchases/games/daily.
economy.currencyHow2: Set a max limit if needed.
economy.dailyList3: The streak resets if daily isn’t claimed in time.
economy.dailyHow2: Save to activate the new rewards.
economy.caption: Currency/daily settings and user balance update.

shops.title: Shop & items
shops.text: Shops display items available to members. Each item has a type (role, inventory, lootbox, IRL) and a price.
shops.list2: Required roles: all must be present to buy.
shops.list4: Hide = item disappears from shop, stays in inventory.
shops.add1: Inside the shop, click Add an item.
shops.add2: Choose the type (role, inventory, lootbox, IRL).
shops.add3: Fill price, description, stock, required roles.
shops.add4: Optional: add an image for a cleaner display.
shops.add5: Save → the item appears immediately to members.
shops.caption: Shop list and items (with hide/delete actions).

lootbox.title: Lootbox
lootbox.text: A lootbox lets members get a random item. Each line is one possible reward.
lootbox.list2: Hide a line = it no longer appears when opening.
lootbox.list3: Hide the lootbox = it disappears from the shop.
lootbox.list4: Rarity colors are shown to users.
lootbox.config1: Create a Lootbox item in a shop.
lootbox.config2: Add lines: type, name, description, chance.
lootbox.config3: Save to make the lootbox purchasable.
lootbox.caption: Lootbox editor (list of possibilities + hide toggle).

inventories.title: Inventories
inventories.text: Admin view of member inventories. You can remove an item or a quantity.
inventories.list1: List of members with at least one item.
inventories.remove2: Click a member to display their items.
inventories.caption: Member inventories with quantity removal.

trash.title: Trash (hidden items)
trash.text: The trash lists hidden items: they are no longer sold but remain in inventories.
trash.how1: Hide an item → it appears in the trash.
trash.how2: From the trash, delete permanently if needed.
trash.caption: Trash section (hidden items / pagination).

automation.title: Automatic gains
automation.text: Automatically reward member activity (messages and voice).
automation.list1: Messages: gain per message with cooldown.
automation.list3: Boosters: multipliers by role and channel.
automation.caption: Automatic gains settings (messages, voice, boosters).

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.text: The leaderboard shows member balances and gives access to full details.
leaderboard.how2: The detail sheet shows gains by day/month.
leaderboard.caption: Balance leaderboard + access to a member’s details.

logs.title: Logs
logs.text: Complete history of economic actions: purchases, sales, gains, games.
logs.list1: Filters by date, source and user.
logs.how2: Filter by action type if needed.
logs.caption: Transaction logs with filters and details.

twitch.title: Twitch
twitch.text: Connect Twitch to reward live activity.
twitch.caption: Twitch settings (connection + reward rules).

games.title: Games
games.text: Games consume currency and can grant rewards. Each game can be enabled/disabled.
games.list1: Slots: random win based on symbols.
games.list2: Double or nothing: double the bet or lose all.
games.list3: Lootbox case opening: open a random case.
games.how1: Games tab → enable the desired game.
games.caption: Games tab (activation + settings).

sensitive.title: Sensitive settings
sensitive.text: Actions that directly impact the economy. Use with caution.
sensitive.list2: Deleting inventory items or shop items.
sensitive.best1: Inform members when making major changes.
sensitive.caption: Sensitive settings (balance, deletion, economy toggle).

faq.title: Admin FAQ
faq.list1: A locked shop requires all required roles.
faq.list2: Hiding an item removes it from the shop but not inventories.
faq.list3: A purchased lootbox applies the configuration at the time of opening.
faq.list4: Games affect the balance in real time.

docUser.title: User Documentation
docUser.subtitle: Complete support guide for members: how to use Discord commands, buy from shops, manage inventory, resell items, open lootboxes and play.

hero.supportText: Actions are synced between Discord and the website.

overview.title: Overview
overview.text: You can earn currency, buy items, resell your goods and play. All actions on the site are also reflected in Discord and vice-versa.
overview.list1: Your balance is visible via /argent or the user space.
overview.list2: Purchases deduct directly from your balance.
overview.list3: Gains (daily, games, boosters) are added automatically.
overview.access2: Choose the server in the user interface.
overview.caption: User home page (balance + quick actions).

shop.title: Shop
shop.text: Shops are organized by category. Each item shows price, description, available quantity and sometimes an image.
shop.list1: A shop can be locked by role.
shop.list2: You can buy roles, inventory items or lootboxes.
shop.how3: Confirm the purchase in the modal.
shop.caption: Shop list and item cards.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.text: Your inventory contains purchased items. Some items can be resold on the market or opened (lootbox).
inventory.how2: Choose an item → open or put on sale.
inventory.caption: User inventory with actions (open/sell).

lootbox.title: Lootbox
lootbox.text: Opening a lootbox gives a random item. Colors indicate rarity.
lootbox.how3: The result is shown at the end of the animation.
lootbox.caption: Lootbox opening animation + result.

market.title: Market / Sell
market.text: You can resell an item from your inventory. Choose the quantity, set the price, and publish the listing. The market shows available quantities.
market.list2: Quantity can be chosen on site and Discord.
market.caption: Market with quantities and buy button.

games.title: Games
games.text: Games consume your currency but can grant rewards.
games.list2: Double or nothing: double the bet or lose it.
games.how3: Start the game and wait for the result.
games.caption: Games page with available game cards.

logs.title: Logs
logs.text: Logs let you track the history of purchases, sales, gains and games.
logs.list1: Filters by date and action type.
logs.how2: Choose a period or action type.
logs.caption: Action history (purchases, sales, gains, games).

faq.list1: If a shop is locked, you need all required roles.

faq.list4: Game winnings are added to the balance immediately.

coinFlip.title: Coin Flip
coinFlip.help: Heads/tails choice. If you win, payout = bet × multiplier. If jackpot is enabled, a second chance can multiply the win.

dice.title: Dice
dice.help: Pick a number between 1 and the number of sides. If it hits, payout = bet × multiplier.

slot.title: Slot Machine
slot.help: 3 random symbols. Exact combos pay per payout table. Two matching symbols use the dedicated multiplier.

roulette.title: Roulette
roulette.help: Outcome is red/black/green based on set chances. If the chosen color hits, payout = bet × color multiplier.

higherLower.title: Higher or Lower
higherLower.help: An initial number is drawn. The player picks higher/lower. If correct, payout = bet × multiplier.

crash.title: Crash
crash.help: Multiplier increases until a random crash. If cashout is below the reached multiplier, payout = bet × cashout. Otherwise you lose.

double.title: Double or Nothing
double.help: A 50/50 draw. If you win, payout = bet × multiplier.

mystery.title: Mystery Box
mystery.help: A multiplier is drawn from the table. Payout = bet × multiplier.
